# Royalseed Agro

> Royalseed Agro, Lda is an Angolan agricultural company developing sustainable, export-oriented Hass avocado production at Lonhe, Quibala, Cuanza Sul, Angola. The company was incorporated in February 2025.

The website is a single page at https://royalseedagro.com/, available in Portuguese (default), English, French, Spanish, Italian, Arabic and Chinese. The language is switched on the page itself; every language shares the same URL.

## Key figures

- Land base: 2,120 hectares
- Planted area, phase one: 500 hectares
- Plants in phase one: 231,000 Hass avocado trees
- Estimated average production: 15,000 tonnes for the 500 hectares of phase one at full production. This is an estimate, not a measured harvest.
- Workforce at harvest: 710 people (350 permanent employees and 360 seasonal employees)

## Mission and vision

- Mission: to develop sustainable avocado production in Angola, building a modern agricultural platform oriented toward export.
- Vision: to become a national and regional reference in production and export, with the capacity to integrate production, logistics and future processing.
- Values: sustainability, innovation, quality, integrity.

## Production strategy

- Efficient fertigation
- Selected, certified seedlings
- Good agricultural practice
- Professional technical management
- Environmental sustainability
- Operations organised for certification

## History

Before moving to implementation, the company invested time in practical learning, technical study and understanding the avocado value chain, both in Angola and at international references such as Kenya.
